page.overview:
Who is Unidentified Dark Lord?

The mummified alchemically-preserved remains of this Dark Lord were located within the Hall of Judgment in the Great Temple at the Valley of the Dark Lords on the planet Korriban.

A Force-sensitive individual served as a Dark Lord of the Sith of the Sith Empire. The deceased body of the Dark Lord, which remained untouched by time, was preserved by the Sith alchemy within the Hall of Judgment in the Great Temple at the Valley of the Dark Lords on the planet Korriban.

After Emperor Palpatine perished aboard the Death Star II, the ancient Dark Lord and at least three other deceased Sith spirits aided Palpatine in his journey out of Chaos back to the living plane of existence and into a clone body.

In 11 ABY, the reborn Palpatine visited the Great Temple, seeking counsel from the spirits of his Sith predecessors in order to restore his decaying clone body. As they traveled through the ancient Sith crypt, the Dark Side Adept T'iaz felt the dark side power emanating from the place. Palpatine explained to him that the ancient Dark Lords were preserved by the Sith alchemy that made them outcasts. The Dark Lord doubted his success and offered him Vader's tomb, but Palpatine declined and instead demanded to be healed. The spirit suggested Palpatine to gaze into the oracle stone, through which Palpatine learned that the only way for him to survive would to to transfer his spirit into Anakin Solo, the newborn son of Princess Leia Organa Solo. The other spirits gave Palpatine counsel and bid him farewell a final time.
